description: Screen company, person and vessel names (or IMO numbers) and crypto wallets against the official OFAC SDN + Consolidated, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions and UK Sanctions Lists in one call. Fuzzy matching with aliases, transliteration (Cyrillic) and legal-form handling, score 0-100, match / possible_match / clear, list version per list, birth-year check. No API key. Only-new mode re-screens your list and returns only new hits. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.02/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/sanctions-screening-api.

birthYear.description: Optional birth year of the person you screen. Listed persons with a different birth year are scored 15 points lower and get a note.

entityType.description: Only match listed entries of this type. any = all types.

limit.description: Most matches returned per screened name (1-50), best first. Default 5.

lists.description: Which official lists to check. Empty = all three: ofac (US Treasury SDN + Consolidated), eu (EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List), uk (UK Sanctions List, FCDO).

mode.description: screen = check names and wallets; lists = show the version, size and freshness of each official list.

names.description: Company, person or vessel names to check, one per line (up to 5,000 per run). A 7-digit IMO number finds a sanctioned ship. Legal forms (LLC, JSC, GmbH...) and accents are handled; Cyrillic names are transliterated.

threshold.description: Lowest similarity score (50-100) that is reported. 92+ = match, threshold..91 = possible_match. Default 80.

wallets.description: Crypto addresses (BTC, ETH, USDT, TRX and others) to check against the digital currency addresses listed by OFAC. EU and UK lists publish no wallet addresses.

name: sanctions_screening_api
title: AML & Sanctions Screening API - OFAC, EU, UK Sanctions & Crypto Wallet Checks
